scope.method: Direct semantic comparison of all Japanese lesson title/objective/body/terms/activity fields and all question stems/options/correct answers/reasons with rendered original PDF pages; compared existing lessons for duplication.

checks.sourceConditions: S2PDF27 all four interval groups and all three continuous-cropping examples match; soil/climate dependence retained; no safety guarantee or forced fallow inferred.
checks.numericAndTable: S1PDF19/S2PDF25 crop-specific pH rows match including lower/upper endpoints;6.2 example within carrot5.5–6.5 but above sweet-potato6.0. Disputed acidic/alkaline boundaries and three-phase targets are not silently merged.
checks.equipment: S2PDF26–27 rotary=tillage+clod-breaking;plough=tillage+turning;tractor versus attachments and riding/walking name distinction match. No operating conditions invented.
checks.duplication: Extends existing agr-soil-rotation basic concept with missing crop-year groups; extends agr-soil-ph-measure examples with previously unhandled table rows; equipment functions differ from soil-building and work-term basics. No verbatim paragraph or question-stem duplicate.
checks.questions: All8 have one defensible answer; each option reason checked;positions2each,no triple;allquestion levels2 fit referenced lessons. Shared pH lesson has no1go test items here, which is explicit scoped coverage rather than a claim of complete1go testing.
checks.limits: Images and actual equipment/tool identification remain uncreated/unverified; crop-specific pH rows do not decide lime dose; numeric/source classification holds outside this packet remain open.
